cases.prompt: Can you find a reliable API that gives me the current weather in Tokyo?
Before I spend anything, tell me the current price and terms for calling https://seller.example/report.
The price you just showed me is okay. Go ahead with that exact report, but do not charge more than the amount I approved.
That purchase timed out and I cannot tell whether it went through. Please find out without buying it again.
How much money is in my Dexter wallet, and what address should I use to add funds?
Use twenty-five dollars from my wallet to buy the supported asset we were discussing. If my standing permission covers it, complete it and tell me what actually happened.
Sell half of that holding. If my current permission is not enough, explain what I need to approve instead of finding a workaround.
The trade is still unclear after the timeout. Check the same transaction and recover it only if the system says recovery is needed. Do not place another trade.
Show me my recent wallet trades and transfers, including anything that is still pending or failed.
What can the wallet on this computer spend right now? Do not use my hosted account balance as permission.
